title: Tarnished Ring
summary: Ring obtainable from Derryth or by combining two broken ring components.

fields.Derryth variant: When offering the original Noblestalk to Derryth, a DC 10 Intimidation check makes her hand over her wedding ring.
fields.Recombined variant: Combine the Gemless Ring with the Ringless Gem. The result is a saleable ring with no verified combat bonus.
fields.Doozy variant: Separate ring belonging to Doozy the Dunce, found in the Guildhall pit at X −23, Y 741.
fields.Base value: 40 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
